_rationale: Taken from the school's own photographs: every block has green window glass against peach plaster and open sky. Green is therefore already the building's accent colour, not an imposed one. Earlier navy+gold read as a generic prestige cliche, maroon and red-oxide both read as synthetic dye, and a full-bleed dark brown hero read muddy. The fix was value as much as hue: the landing section is now a LIGHT field so the photographs carry the colour, with deep green reserved for type and the results/footer bands.

ink.role: deep forest — results band and footer only

greenSoft.role: muted green — italic type, secondary icons

stone.role: sage-grey — utility icons, date blocks, metadata

brass.role: aged brass accent — rules, small fills

brassLight.role: accent tint — type and hairlines on dark fields

brassDark.role: accent darkened for small text on cream (5.2:1)

peach.role: tint echoing the building's plaster — hero wash, soft panels

error.role: form validation and 'unverified' flags ONLY — never a brand colour

display.note: soft serif with optical sizing — heritage without stuffiness

body.note: deliberately not Inter/Roboto, which read as template defaults

devanagari.note: The motto is set BOLD (700) in a band at the top of the page, above the hero — it is the school's own line and reads as a statement, not a footnote.

shadows.note: warm-tinted — a cool shadow on a warm ground reads grey and muddy

motion.note: scroll reveals, counters and hover lifts only — no parallax; all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

motif.arch: Arched media frames reference school architecture and let a missing photograph read as an intentional frame rather than a broken image.

_source_of_truth_note: Hex values are a designed system informed by the school's building photographs, not sampled from the original logo file. Re-check against the crest once a high-resolution or vector logo asset is supplied.

crestColours._note: Read from the crest image supplied by the school on 2026-09-20. NOT yet sampled from a source vector/high-res file — approximate.
crestColours.navy: deep navy wordmark and ray burst
crestColours.magenta: Saraswati disc background and the Devanagari motto
crestColours._conflict: The crest is navy/red/magenta/gold; the site palette is earth-derived. Reconcile before launch — either place the crest on limewash where it reads cleanly, or request a single-colour crest variant from the school.

layout.heroField: light — the landing section must not be a dark full-bleed field; photographs carry the colour
layout.mottoPlacement: top band, directly beneath the header, above the hero
